title: Machine Learning-Driven Prediction of Early Enteral Nutrition Intolerance in ICU Patients Using Intra-Abdominal Pressure and Selected Gut Microbial Taxa.
summary: retrospective 300-patient ICU cohort split 240/60; LASSO feature selection and nomogram combine IAP, gut taxa and clinical factors; AUC 0.900 in both development and internal holdout. Small single-center validation and no external/generalizability evidence.
